title: Legacy Text Input Contract Audit, TTUTIL Suitability & Adapter Qualification
qualification_scope: source-bound revision-53 input-family inventory, parser/normalization/scientific boundary, defaults and error-contract audit, TTUTIL suitability classification, normalized parser-equivalence model, negative-case architecture, official TTUTIL 4.27 source provenance and bounded pilot selection; no production input migration
principal_findings: TTUTIL 4.27 source provenance is now exact and independently hash-pinned from the supplied SWAP 4.3.1 distribution
the public SWAP-model/ttutil repository is not byte-identical to the official SWAP 4.3.1 embedded TTUTIL and is reference-only
TTUTIL remains useful parser infrastructure but is not a drop-in parser for the revision-53 legacy grammar
LegacyRevision53TextAdapter and TTUTILNativeTextAdapter/v1 are now explicitly separate representation contracts
ANIMO41 GENERAL named records are sequentially order-sensitive while TTUTIL reading is name-based and order-independent
INITIAL and restart state remain specialized state adapters
external crop and soil-temperature time series remain specialized forcing/exchange adapters
GHGMais remains rejected under the revision-53 adapter until a provenance-qualified versioned lineage exists

pilot_selection.pilot_B_candidate: MAT non-GHG static core after Pilot A
pilot_selection.remaining_requirement: implement and qualify legacy DIRECT normalization plus native TTUTIL DIRECT normalization and compare field-exact outputs

next_safe_steps: implement exact LegacyRevision53TextAdapter DIRECT normalization and negative cases
add deterministic TTUTIL 4.27 materialization/verification tooling without automatic WUR registration or download
implement a native TTUTIL DIRECT v1 parser probe against the exact official source
compare both DIRECT representations at normalized LegacyInputBinding level
only then classify Pilot A and proceed to MATERIAL
